tagline.cn: 外籍旅客。签证在倒计时。目标：活着从香港出去。
tagline.en: Foreign traveler. Visa clock ticking. Goal: leave via Hong Kong — alive.

body.cn: 选签证 → 在城市点景点过日子 → 换城赶路 → 去香港离境。其余规则，自己撞。
body.en: Pick a visa → burn days on city pins → travel between cities → exit via Hong Kong. The rest: learn by colliding.

body.cn: 钱 · 精神 · 时间 · 电量 · 本地化。归零通常很糟。具体怎么涨跌，玩了才知道。
body.en: Money · Sanity · Time · Battery · Locality. Hitting zero is usually bad. How they move: discover in play.

body.cn: 教程里的选择会留下后果。有的门要钥匙，有的路看起来便宜其实很贵。
body.en: Tutorial choices leave consequences. Some doors need keys; some cheap paths are expensive.
